_comment: Definitions only (static). Instances — level, condition, site — are stored in SettlementState.buildings. Level 1 is described by cost/build_days/requires/effects; every entry of `upgrades` describes the next level (its effects REPLACE the previous level's). Effects: population_capacity, storage_capacity, military_strength are additive across buildings; production is per in-game day; worker_slots is how many residents can be assigned; production_per_worker is added per assigned resident. build_days/days 0 = finished immediately, otherwise a construction job runs. placement 'reserved' = only on the village site reserved for it (see data/village/village_layouts.json); otherwise any free plot. Visuals are looked up as building.<id>.level_<n> in data/visuals/visual_registry.json — nothing here names an image.

village_hearth.name: Village Hearth
village_hearth.description: The fire Emberfall is named for. While it burns, people gather, plan and stay.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.description: A dry roof and a wall between you and the night. Lets more people stay.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.description: A bench, a few salvaged tools and somewhere dry to use them.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.description: Stacked timber, stone and sacks under whatever cover can be found.

watchpost.name: Watchpost
watchpost.description: A raised platform with a view of the roads. Someone has to be looking.

woodcutters_camp.name: Woodcutter's Camp
woodcutters_camp.description: Villagers fell timber from the Greywood edge each day.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.description: Keeps the rain off what you bring back. Raises the storage cap.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.description: Sharpened stakes around the village. The first thing a raider will see.
